# Product Management Target in London

You’re best positioned for **Senior Product Manager** or **Product Manager II** roles in **London** with a **hybrid** setup and a **GBP 85,000+ base** target. Given 5 years in fintech, you should bias toward regulated, payments, lending, wealth, or platform products where domain knowledge is valued.

## Role Target and Search Filters

| Area | Recommended target |
|---|---|
| Role title | Senior Product Manager; Product Manager II; Product Lead |
| Location | London, UK; UK-based only; willing to relocate within the UK |
| Work model | Hybrid, ideally 2–3 days in office |
| Compensation floor | **GBP 85,000 base** minimum |
| Experience match | 5 years in fintech; strong fit for regulated product environments |
| Best company types | Fintechs, banks, payments, embedded finance, B2B SaaS with financial products |
| Interview start | **2026-08** |

### Job-Search Filter Checklist

- **Location:** London only, or UK-wide with relocation allowed
- **Work model:** Hybrid; exclude fully remote unless UK-based and flexible
- **Base salary:** Filter for **GBP 85k+**
- **Level:** Senior PM, PM II, Lead PM, Group PM if scope fits
- **Domain:** Fintech, payments, lending, banking, risk, compliance, wealth
- **Product type:** B2C, B2B, platform, or API products in financial services
- **Visa/relocation:** UK-only roles; no outside-UK relocation required
- **Hiring timing:** Prioritize roles open for late-2026 interviewing or pipeline-building now
- **Team fit:** Cross-functional product roles with engineering, design, data, and commercial partners
- **Deal-breakers:** Below salary floor, fully onsite, non-UK relocation, junior scope

### Recruiter Message

Hi [Name],

I’m a product manager with **5 years of fintech experience** and am currently targeting **Senior Product Manager / Product Manager II** roles in **London**. I’m looking for a **hybrid** role with a **base salary of at least GBP 85,000**, and I’m open to relocating within the UK if needed.

My background includes working on fintech products in regulated environments, partnering closely with engineering, design, and commercial teams to deliver measurable product outcomes. I’d be glad to explore roles where my domain experience and execution focus could add value.

If you’re hiring for relevant roles, I’d be happy to share my CV and discuss fit.

Best,
[Your Name]

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Search roles](https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/)
Action: [Button: Browse fintech jobs](https://www.efinancialcareers.com/jobs-UK-London)
Action: [Button: Salary check](https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Salaries/index.htm)

## Sources

- LinkedIn Jobs: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/
- eFinancialCareers UK jobs: https://www.efinancialcareers.com/jobs-UK-London
- Glassdoor salaries: https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Salaries/index.htm
